name: Modals
purpose: Modals focus the user's attention on an important message or side-task without removing them from their journey. Family: Dialog (interrupts the view and requires an action/decision to continue), Video modal (responsive video overlay), and Partial modal / Drawer (app-only, anchored to the bottom of the screen, houses supplementary content/actions the user can view and interact with alongside the underlying UI).
$family: Covers the 'Modals' canvas across three sections: Modal - dialog, Modal - video, Modal - partial (app only).

props.name: buttons
props.$note: Dialog button layout (single / two side-by-side / stacked).

props.name: breakpoint
props.$note: Video modal is fully responsive (XL scale-3 → XS scale-1); S/XS use a dedicated layout.

variants.name: dialog
variants.use: Overlay that interrupts the user and requires an action/decision. Non-native; buttons default / two-buttons / stacked. ('Dialogs for mobile').

variants.name: video
variants.use: Responsive video-player overlay (XL/L/M/MS/S/XS). Surface + close + caption over a dimmed, blurred backdrop.

variants.name: partial
variants.use: App-only Drawer anchored to the bottom; supplementary content/actions; elevate above level 0 (shadow at rest, overlay when expanded). Include search where appropriate.

tokens.title: text/default @ font-4/regular (dialog) / font-5 medium
tokens.backdrop: overlay/version1 (#00000080 — 50% black scrim) + blur/overlay (12, dark=0) applied as a BACKGROUND_BLUR effect ('overlay blur'). NOTE: Figma surfaced the blur radius as 'overlay/background-blur' but it resolves to the store token blur/overlay.
tokens.elevation: Drawer sits above level 0 — shadow at rest, overlay when expanded (see elevation guidance)
tokens.$finding: (2026-06-20) Dialog surface rebound to tertiary/background/default (raised #1D1D1D in dark) so it is visible — background/default (#000) would vanish on the dimmed page. Elevation = shadow(light)/elevation-border(dark). Note: the overlay dim is ineffective over a pure-#000 page (black-on-black) — real app content behind it provides the dim.

commonPatterns: bottom drawer / sheet with supplementary actions

accessibility.focusTrap: REVIEW (inferred): focus must be trapped within the modal while open and returned to the trigger on close
accessibility.dismiss: Provide a close affordance; Esc should dismiss dialogs (drawers may be swipe-dismiss on app)
accessibility.role: Use role=dialog / aria-modal with an accessible name (title); video modal needs accessible media controls
accessibility.backdrop: The dimmed/blurred scrim must not be the only way to convey modality; underlying content is inert while open
accessibility.targetArea: Close and action controls min 44px target

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): stacking multiple modals/dialogs at once
Using a dialog (interrupting, requires a decision) where a non-blocking drawer or inline message would suffice
Drawer left at level 0 without elevation (shadow at rest / overlay when expanded)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — CLEAN across Dialog, Video and Partial; no deprecated tokens.
tokenValidation.newTokenGroupSeen: overlay/* — the modal backdrop: overlay/version1 (#00000080 scrim, dark too) + blur radius blur/overlay (12, dark 0) applied as a BACKGROUND_BLUR effect. First component to surface overlay/version1; the blur radius reuses the blur/* group (blur/overlay) seen alongside blur/background-surface on Hero. (Figma flattened the radius var name to 'overlay/background-blur' but it maps to blur/overlay.)
tokenValidation.primitiveBinding: Section tint binds primitive colour/neutral/grey-1 (#f3f3f3) directly — same primitive-leak flag noted on List/Badge/Hero.

build.$status: PROMOTED 2026-06-22 (Dave) — gated reference: snippets/Modals.reference.html (DIALOG variant). Build green; prototype-grade 9.0/9 (board: 7 at 9/9).
build.scope: Dialog only. Video modal + Partial/drawer remain a separate, larger follow-up (flagged, not built).
build.buttonInheritance: CTAs are the canon Button (mirror of Button.reference.html) — primary/secondary + the promoted scale-physics. Atom-reuse, not a bespoke button. Secondary border corrected to tertiary/border/default (was form/border).
build.fidelity: Primary button ordered FIRST (left in a row / top when stacked), left-aligned — per Figma node 1076:73406; the prior canon had it last/right-aligned.
build.motion: Scale + fade entrance on the SAME spring as the button (motion/easing/spring @ motion/duration/spring); backdrop fades (motion/duration/fade). Reduced-motion snaps. Chosen (Dave) to mirror the button motion language.
build.backdrop: DIM scrim (overlay/version1), NOT blur. Decision (Dave 2026-06-22): dim preserves glance-ability of the page and avoids the low-vision/legibility + cognitive cost of backdrop blur (documented a11y hazard; OSes ship 'Reduce Transparency'; blur/overlay is 0 in dark anyway). If blur is ever used it must gate behind prefers-reduced-transparency and never be a load-bearing modality cue.
build.a11y: role=dialog + aria-modal + aria-labelledby + aria-describedby; focus moves in + Tab trapped within + Esc closes + focus returns to trigger; background inert; trigger disabled while open. Closes the meta's focus-trap REVIEW item.
build.prototypeGrade: 9.0/9 (2026-06-22). Square corners; responsive actions stack <=480px (Figma 'stacked' form).
